confirmedFacts: Denver's official final report says all 53 Broncos are expected available; Marvin Mims Jr. practiced fully and has no game designation.
Chiefs LT Josh Simmons is ruled out with a back injury; undrafted rookie Kahlil Benson is expected to start at LT.
Chiefs DB Chamarri Conner is ruled out. No other Chiefs player has a game designation; Patrick Mahomes is expected to play after full practice participation.
Bo Nix has publicly stated the surgically repaired ankle will not hinder him; Denver has described him as ready for regular-season action.

weather.summary: Arrowhead forecast carries roughly 10-12 mph wind with a meaningful rain chance; Covers notes forecast disagreement on storm timing and possible gusts. Treat as a mild-to-moderate passing-environment downgrade pending game-day refresh, not a standalone prop trigger.

evaluations.reason: Nix is healthy enough for normal mobility, but the independent projections are only modestly above 14.5 and do not support a robust 4-5 percentage-point edge at typical -115 pricing. Do not promote without a live price at -110 or better or a stronger game-day mobility/pressure catalyst.
